description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultJavaScriptConfig class within the JavaScript configuration mapping of the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies immutability, equality, and configuration value retrieval behaviors.

classes.name: DefaultJavaScriptConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultJavaScriptConfig, verifying its immutability, equality, and configuration value fetching.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by loading the JavaScript test configuration before tests run.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that DefaultJavaScriptConfig and its associated JavaScriptConfig interface are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that DefaultJavaScriptConfig's hashCode and equals methods behave correctly using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: underTestReturnsDefaultValuesIfBaseConfigWasEmpty
methods.description: Checks that default values are returned when the configuration is empty.

methods.name: underTestReturnsValuesOfConfigFile
methods.description: Ensures that configuration values are correctly read from the provided configuration file.
